mission: Cut through the market noise, tell only what is fact, zero fear, zero greed, and empower retail investors with actionable clarity.

creator_persona.name: SaN
creator_persona.tone: Authentic, relatable peer, direct, pragmatic, respectful
creator_persona.delivery_style: Fast-paced, conversational, non-academic, zero fluff, straight to the point
banned_intro_phrases: Without wasting any time let us get into the video
Make sure to like and subscribe before we start
I am opening the screener website right now

zero_fear_policy.transformation_rule: Replace panic with structural explanation: Why did prices move? What was the liquidity or valuation driver?

zero_greed_policy.transformation_rule: Replace speculative greed with risk-adjusted reality: What are the fundamentals, debt levels, and valuation multiples?

evidence_paper.description: 3D tilted card with simulated yellow highlighter over key fact or headline

stock_pills.description: Floating ticker pills with company logo and clean metrics

ui_walkthrough.description: Step 1, Step 2, Step 3 badges and pulsing ripple pointer for app walkthroughs

comparison_card.description: Split screen or side-by-side battle with green checks and red Xs

financial_chart.description: Animated cubic bezier line chart with glow dot and milestone callouts

kinetic_captions.description: 3-5 words at a time with mint green / electric blue word highlights
